funnel.note: team_rooms_observed counts only rooms this run could actually read (retained>0); see provenance.caveats for why that is smaller than teams_allocated. outcomes partitions ALL candidate rooms (submitted/complete_not_submitted/stalled/never_started/unreadable are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; flooded is a separate overlay, see room_outcome()).

caveats: team_rooms_observed is smaller than teams_allocated by construction: the sources only reveal a room when it was listed in a 4-hourly referee intake snapshot, appears on an accepted or attempted submission, or was visible within the discovery room's retained window -- teams that never surfaced in any of those three ways are invisible to this measurement.

mb-sonnet-2-discovery retains only its most recent few thousand messages; poem_room values from earlier in the contest are not recoverable from it, so the discovery-derived slice of the team-room union is a lower bound, not a complete list.

per-room max_version is a lower bound whenever window_truncated is true (retained >= 200, i.e. the ?limit=200 read cap was hit): earlier room history beyond the returned window may hold a higher accepted version. When retained < 200 the read is the room's whole history (rooms are contiguous from seq 1 or 2), so nothing was cut and max_version is exact.

76/239 read team rooms have window_truncated=true (hit the 200-message cap); rooms below the cap that show max_version 0 only ever posted the referee's setup record (and/or unchained flood words) -- see outcome=never_started, not a truncation artifact.
sonnet.receipts.v1 (plural, batch) messages in the submissions export are not parsed into the accept/reject counts below, which are built from individual sonnet.receipt.v1 records only.
